name: Shanghai International Settlement (1863–1943)
description: A white field with a red cross and saltire; at the centre the municipal seal displaying the flags of the treaty powers around the motto 'Omnia Juncta in Uno'.
history: Flag of the Shanghai Municipal Council governing the International Settlement, the treaty-port enclave whose seal joined the flags of its founding powers 'all joined in one'. The settlement ended in 1943.

features.role: municipal seal with treaty-power flags — 'Omnia Juncta in Uno'
